SELECT c.Segment,
       SUM(t.Amount) AS total_amount
FROM customers c
JOIN "transactions_1k" t ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE c.Currency = g.Country
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY c.Segment;

SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
GROUP BY c.Segment

SELECT c.Segment AS segment, SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_transaction_amount FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country = c.Currency GROUP BY c.Segment;

votes.sql:
WITH cust_gas AS (
    SELECT g."ChainID" AS CustomerID, t.Amount
    FROM gasstations g
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    WHERE g."ChainID" IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Amount) AS total_amount
    FROM cust_gas
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT CustomerID,
       total_amount,
       rnk
FROM (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           total_amount,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rnk
    FROM agg
) sub
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY rnk, CustomerID;

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        t.CustomerID,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS total_amount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC) AS rank_num
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    total_amount,
    rank_num
FROM customer_totals
WHERE rank_num <= 3;

WITH cust_gs_month AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.GasStationID,
                    substr(t.Date,1,4) || substr(t.Date,6,2) AS ym_date,
                    t.CustomerID
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
)
SELECT cg.GasStationID,
       cg.ym_date AS "Date",
       SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM cust_gs_month cg
JOIN "yearmonth" ym
  ON cg.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
 AND cg.ym_date = ym.Date
GROUP BY cg.GasStationID, cg.ym_date
ORDER BY cg.GasStationID, cg.ym_date;

WITH qualified_customers AS (
    SELECT "CustomerID"
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE substr("Date",1,4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY "CustomerID"
    HAVING SUM("Consumption") > 1500
),
monthly_station_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        t."GasStationID",
        strftime('%Y%m', t."Date") AS ym,
        SUM(t."Amount") AS total_amount
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    JOIN qualified_customers qc ON t."CustomerID" = qc."CustomerID"
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t."Date") = '2013'
    GROUP BY t."GasStationID", ym
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT ym, MAX(total_amount) AS max_amount
    FROM monthly_station_consumption
    GROUP BY ym
)
SELECT DISTINCT msc."GasStationID"
FROM monthly_station_consumption msc
JOIN monthly_max mm ON msc.ym = mm.ym AND msc.total_amount = mm.max_amount;

WITH qualified_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(Consumption) > 1500
),
station_totals AS (
    SELECT t.GasStationID, SUM(t.Amount) AS total_amount
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN qualified_customers qc ON t.CustomerID = qc.CustomerID
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2013'
    GROUP BY t.GasStationID
)
SELECT GasStationID
FROM station_totals
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM station_totals);

WITH "cust_2013" AS (
    SELECT "CustomerID", SUM("Consumption") AS total_cons
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE "Date" BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY "CustomerID"
    HAVING SUM("Consumption") > 1500
),
"txn" AS (
    SELECT t."CustomerID",
           substr(replace(t."Date", '-', ''),1,6) AS yearmonth,
           t."GasStationID",
           SUM(t."Amount") AS amount
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    JOIN "cust_2013" c ON t."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
    WHERE substr(replace(t."Date", '-', ''),1,6) BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY t."CustomerID", yearmonth, t."GasStationID"
),
"ranked" AS (
    SELECT "CustomerID", yearmonth, "GasStationID",
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "CustomerID", yearmonth ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM "txn"
)
SELECT DISTINCT "GasStationID"
FROM "ranked"
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH visit_counts AS (
    SELECT t."CustomerID", t."GasStationID", COUNT(*) AS visits
    FROM "transactions_1k" t

ranked AS (

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY vc."CustomerID" ORDER BY vc.visits DESC) AS rn
    FROM visit_counts vc
)
SELECT c."CustomerID", gs."GasStationID"
FROM ranked r
JOIN "customers" c ON c."CustomerID" = r."CustomerID"
JOIN "gasstations" gs ON gs."GasStationID" = r."GasStationID"

WITH ranked_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Date,
        Consumption,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Date ORDER BY Consumption DESC) as rn
    FROM yearmonth
),
top_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Date, Consumption
    FROM ranked_consumption
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT t.GasStationID
FROM top_customers tc
JOIN transactions_1k t ON tc.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) = tc.Date

WITH monthly_station AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y%m', t."Date") AS month,
    g."GasStationID",
    SUM(ym."Consumption") AS total_consumption
  FROM "yearmonth" ym
  JOIN "customers" c ON ym."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
  JOIN "transactions_1k" t ON t."CustomerID" = ym."CustomerID"
                         AND strftime('%Y%m', t."Date") = ym."Date"
  JOIN "gasstations" g ON t."GasStationID" = g."GasStationID"
  GROUP BY month, g."GasStationID"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    "GasStationID",
    total_consumption,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY total_consumption DESC) AS rn
  FROM monthly_station
)
SELECT
  month,
  "GasStationID",
  total_consumption
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY month;
